description: This PHP class 'EditAttendanceController' manages the logic for editing attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and uses traits to handle attendance services, mainly implementing pre-rendering logic to validate request attributes, retrieve attendance data, check permissions, and set up a Vue component for editing attendance.

classes.name: EditAttendanceController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the editing of attendance records, including validation, permission checks, and setting up the Vue component for the frontend.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by validating the request, retrieving the attendance record, checking permissions, and initializing the Vue component with attendance data.
